staged_tree_reproducibility.note: image IDs differ between builds (build-timestamp metadata); the staged tree content hash and the image tag do not

sandbox_memory_selection.method: bounded search, cgroup v2 memory.peak (true high-water mark, not a sampled maximum)

concurrency_observation.reason: OpenShell v0.0.96 names its supervisor-extraction container with a fixed name; two gateways bootstrapping concurrently against one container runtime collide with a Docker 409

transient_operational_note.observation: under concurrent load, sandbox download exited 1 twice across the engagement (out of >150 download operations) and succeeded on an immediate retry both times
transient_operational_note.response: a bounded, disclosed retry (max 2 extra attempts) was added to download operations only, never to exec or upload; every attempt is recorded, and an exhausted retry still reaches driver_errors
transient_operational_note.why_this_is_safe: a download only re-reads a file the sandbox already finished writing; it cannot touch the presentation or authorization boundary

intentional_failure_verification.injection: removed the refund.execute allow rule from the OpenShell policy
intentional_failure_verification.parser_coverage: FAIL (0/10 admitted; the safety invariant held under a deny-all policy while coverage correctly did not)

proof_carriage.measurement: SHA-256 and byte length only; no proof body, delegation body, or certificate retained in this summary
